# BARBER-HUB

> The global streaming platform and FIFA-style tournament for head-to-head barber battles. Fans vote on live competitions, sponsor barbers, and earn Barber Bucks (BB); barbers compete, educate, and withdraw real value.

BARBER-HUB unifies discovery, live competition, and an in-app currency (Barber Bucks) into one ecosystem. Barbers stream battles, run tournaments, list services, and build a reputation tied to nationality. Fans find barbers near them, vote in PK battles, and back their favorite competitors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Live battles, featured barbers, and what BARBER-HUB is about.
- [Barbers Directory](/barbers): Discover and book barbers worldwide, filter by location and specialty.
- [Watch Feed](/watch): Vertical feed of live battles, highlights, and barber clips.
- [Tournaments](/tournaments): FIFA-style barber tournaments, brackets, and prize pools.
- [Book a Barber Near Me](/book-barber-near-me): Find and book a local barber in 15 miles.
- [Vault of Honor](/vault): Champions, season records, and faction history.
- [Grants](/grants): Mentor-for-Mentor (M4M) charity fund and barber grant programs.
